Mobilen planlegger hoppstiger og lar ing: The phone plans its hop ladders and leaves no peg behind. Can you beat it?

Kinasjakk: Flytt alle de ti brikkene din: Chinese checkers: move all ten of your pegs across the star into the point straight opposite. Whoever fills it first wins.
Flytt en brikke til et ledig hull ved si: Move a peg to a free hole next to it – in any of the six directions.
Hopp over én brikke (din egen eller en a: Hop over one peg (yours or anyone's) into the free hole right behind it. If you can hop on from there, you may – as far as you like, in the same move.
Få alle ti brikkene inn i spissen rett o: Get all ten pegs into the point straight opposite. A peg that has arrived stays there. First home wins.
Lag hoppstiger: Brikker med ett hull mel: Build hop ladders: pegs with one hole between them are a motorway across the board.
Ikke glem de bakerste brikkene – én brik: Don't forget the pegs at the back – one left at home can cost you the game.
Trykk på en brikke, så viser prikkene hv: Tap a peg and the dots show where it can go. You can tap just beside a hole – the nearest one that fits is chosen.
Mobilene spiller de tomme plassene. Med: The phone plays the empty seats. With 2, 3, 4 or 6 seats there is always someone to beat.
Etter 150 runder vinner den som har komm: After 150 rounds whoever has come furthest wins. Tapped the wrong hole? «Undo» takes your move back.
Hvordan vil du spille?: How do you want to play?
Dere sender mobilen rundt. Tomme plasser: Pass the phone round. The phone plays the empty seats.
